ruefully

ROO-ful-ee · adverb

Hear It

What It Means

Ruefully is in a way that shows sorrow or regret, often with a wry or self-deprecating tone.

"I really should have read the instructions first," he said ruefully, staring at the pile of extra screws left over from the bookshelf.

Example

Looking back at her overflowing closet, Elena admitted ruefully that she'd bought the exact same sweater in three different colors without noticing.

Ruefully describes tone -- a way of speaking or reacting that shows someone regrets something, often while half-laughing at their own mistake.

Compare the words

Synonyms · words with a similar meaning

regretfully: Regretfully simply marks that regret is present -- 'regretfully, we must decline' is formal and can be entirely solemn. Ruefully adds a wry, self-mocking twist: the speaker is half-smiling at their own mistake even while owning it.

remorsefully: Remorsefully carries deep moral weight -- real guilt over a wrong done to someone. Ruefully is far lighter: a rueful shake of the head suits a harmless blunder you can already laugh at, not a wrong that demands forgiveness.

What it isn’t · antonyms and near-opposites

proudly: in a way that shows satisfaction or self-approval

gleefully: in a way that shows great delight

Where it sits · how heavy the regret sounds

apologetically → ruefully → despairingly

apologetically vs. ruefully: Saying 'sorry' apologetically is a simple, polite acknowledgment aimed at someone else -- lighter than ruefully, which turns the regret wryly back on yourself.

despairingly vs. ruefully: Reacting despairingly suggests a much deeper, hopeless sadness than a wry, rueful shrug.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — rue: to feel regret about something (Old English hreowan)

suffix — -ful: full of (Old English)

suffix — -ly: in the manner of (Old English)

Put it together: Ruefully comes from rue ("to regret") + -ful ("full of") + -ly ("in the manner of") -- literally "in a manner full of regret."

Use the root in a new word: rue: The chess club calls Maya's endgame style absolutely ruthless.
